outcome_detail: Lawsuit filed March 6, 2026; no resolution reported as of July 2026. Scheublin was criminally charged and fired from the NYPD in July 2026.
criminal_detail: Jeremy Scheublin was arrested July 10, 2026, and indicted by a Bronx grand jury on eight counts including first-degree attempted rape, first-degree sexual abuse, assault, unlawful imprisonment, forcible touching, official misconduct and obstructing governmental administration. He pleaded not guilty, was released on $75,000 bond or $25,000 cash bail, was fired by the NYPD after his arrest, and has a next court appearance scheduled for October 30, 2026.
incident_date_approx: Alleged assault on January 1, 2025, in the commanding officer's office at the 46th Precinct; alleged harassment beginning after Scheublin took command in December 2023.
description: A Black female NYPD officer, identified in court papers as N.T., filed a lawsuit in March 2026 against the NYPD and Inspector Jeremy Scheublin, then the commanding officer of the Bronx's 46th Precinct. The complaint alleges Scheublin pursued her with unwanted advances after taking command in December 2023, told her he wanted to 'make biracial babies' with her, and on January 1, 2025, summoned her to his office, placed his hand around her neck, threw her onto a couch and attempted to kiss her, with the encounter ending after she kicked him in the groin. The suit also alleges retaliation after she reported the assault, including a denied transfer request and unfavorable shift assignments. In July 2026, Bronx prosecutors charged Scheublin with attempted rape and other counts arising from the alleged assault; he pleaded not guilty and was fired by the NYPD. The civil case is ongoing.
notes: Companion record rec-60b covers a separate July 2026 sexual-harassment lawsuit by three other female officers from the same 46th Precinct.
